programme.title: Why does someone have a new date prediction
programme.desc:
Every week it seems someone has a new date A new prediction A new timeline A new claim that they know exactly when a major financial event will occur when the Federal Reserve will end or when a new system will emerge
The problem is that these predictions almost never come true When dates are set and those dates pass without the promised event people become discouraged frustrated and disappointed Many begin questioning information that may otherwise have value simply because someone claimed certainty about something no one could truly know The reality is that there are countless factors involved in major economic and political changes Many decisions happen behind closed doors Governments central banks world events legislation international agreements and unforeseen circumstances can all affect timelines None of us has access to every piece of information That is why it is important to focus on facts rather than speculation principles rather than predictions and preparation rather than dates In this video Dr Scott Young discusses the dangers of date-setting why so many predictions fail and how to approach financial and economic developments with wisdom patience and discernment
